verdicts.rationale: Both tests are alternative diagnostic procedures used to detect heteroskedasticity in your regression models.
The Goldfeld-Quandt test statistic is fundamentally an F-test comparing the ratio of variances from two subsamples.
Both procedures serve the same ultimate purpose of testing for heteroskedasticity, but via different test construction methodologies.
The Goldfeld-Quandt test uses an F-distribution rather than a t-statistic for its hypothesis evaluation.
